'''Everis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Everis was among the scientists working on the [[Project Noble Focus]], which forced alien inmates of different species to compete against each other to learn their strenths and weaknesses. However, around [[3641 BBY]] a [[Invasion of Belsavis|riot]] broke out and many of the prisoners involved in the project got free. In particular, a group of escaped [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] went insane, hunting down those respobsible for their torture and capturing many of Everis' colleagues. Realizing the horror of the project, Everis begged a Republic citizen to rescue the prisoners from the Gand.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Everis appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, where he begins the heroic mission "A Lesson is Learned."
